perspectives.title: Lawyers/legal professionals: has your kid ever pulled the “my mom/dad is a lawyer!” card? How do you feel?
perspectives.snippet: Top comment · Sort of. My son’s friend did something dumb (potentially criminal) at school in 9th grade. The assistant principal and resource officer (a sheriff’s deputy) called my son down to the office and asked him questions that suggested they believed my son was involved. My son told them he would feel more comfortable with me there and the assistant principal said “You might have a right to a lawyer but not to a parent” to which my son responded “My dad is also my lawyer.” They stopped asking him questions and he went about his day.
